_comment: Bol -> strokes (data/tabla/strokes.json) played together, each with a level (0..1). The taal files (data/taal/, step 6) may use only these names (case-insensitive); the generator fails with a clear error on any other. Entries marked 'doubtful' are choices to confirm with ElectroNick (PROGRESS.md).

_doubtful.Ta: played as Na (common in Teentaal's theka); some schools distinguish it
_doubtful.Dhi, Di: played as Dhin (Ge + Tin); some schools play Dhi as Ge + Ti
_doubtful.Ki, Kat, Kit: played as Ke (closed bayan); Kit/Kat may also be closed dayan strokes
_doubtful.Tin: na-open stands in (the pack has no Tin)
_doubtful.Dhet: the pack's 'dhec' (a closed dayan stroke) under the name Dhet; no Ge under it
_doubtful.Tas: the pack's 'tas' (closed, resonant): a name of convenience, not a standard bol
_doubtful.Meend: Ge with the wrist's glide (the pack's long ghe takes): a name of convenience, so it can be played
